title: The Holiday Party Edit
note: Silk is a protein fiber spun by the silkworm. It takes dye deeper than any other fiber and weighs almost nothing, which is why it moves and catches light the way nothing else does in a dark room.

title: New Arrivals
note: The newest pieces to pass the label check, shell and lining read separately.

title: Sweaters
note: Animal fiber all the way through. No acrylic to pill, no nylon to trap heat, and a sweater that gets softer with every wash instead of worse.

title: Black Tie Ready
note: Gowns, columns and bias cuts in silk or velvet. Check the lining line on each card, because that is where a formal dress most often gives up the fiber story.

title: Low, Mid, High
note: A collar, a short button placket and a close fit. The same idea at three prices, so you can see where the money goes. Mostly it goes to the fiber.

picks.label: Low
picks.note: Seventy percent cotton, thirty percent cashmere, in a rib with contrast tipping.

picks.label: Mid
picks.note: One hundred percent cashmere, cut close through the body and the sleeve.

picks.label: High
picks.note: One hundred percent cashmere in a softer, easier shape.

title: This Moment: Fringe
note: Fringe is back on knits, coats and skirts. These are leather, wool and cashmere all the way through, so the movement comes from the material itself.

picks.note: Seventy percent wool, thirty percent cashmere, with fringe across the back and down the sleeves.
One hundred percent leather, fringe included. The lining is lyocell, and it says so below.
Wool and cashmere and unlined, with fringe that moves when you walk.

title: Sets
note: Two pieces cut from one cloth, so they match now and still work alone in March. Jumpsuits included.

title: Quality Basics
note: Tees, tanks, turtlenecks, cardigans and trousers in cotton, wool, cashmere and silk with nothing synthetic in the shell. The price is the fiber, not the logo.

title: The Western Edit
note: Suede and shearling are hides, which makes them the oldest natural fibers on the site. They break in where you wear them and they do not come back from a wash, so buy them to keep.
